provenance.source: 字源 (2012), p.145 / printed p.133, 邊(边) entry
provenance.scope: Only four exact OCR literals 昪 at [1618,1619), [1662,1663), [1750,1751), [1809,1810) on PDF p.145; proposed printed literal 臱. No producer write.

occurrences.reason: In attachment 2, the complete paragraph crop shows the target after “形声字。从辵,” and before “声” as a compact upper cluster over a lower enclosed shape with a central horizontal stroke. This differs from the OCR’s 昪. The same crop visibly prints 臱 in the later phrase “声符‘臱’下半部”; its lower enclosure and inner stroke match the target.

In attachment 2, after “金文或从” and before “为止的变形,” the target has the same compact upper cluster and lower enclosed shape with a central horizontal stroke as the adjacent quoted glyph. The same crop prints that control in “声符‘臱’下半部,” where it is visibly 臱; the target’s lower part does not match 昪.

In attachment 2, the target after “至于汉代，声符” and before “下半部进而讹作” is a compact upper cluster over an enclosed lower shape with a central horizontal stroke. The same crop prints 臱 as the quoted control in the preceding “声符‘臱’下半部”; those visible parts match, unlike 昪.

In attachment 2, after “替换繁冗的” and before “形” in “现代简化字以‘力’替换繁冗的‘臱’形,” the target shows a compact upper cluster over a lower enclosure with a central horizontal stroke. The same crop’s earlier quoted control in “声符‘臱’下半部” has that same visible structure, supporting 臱 rather than OCR 昪.
